title: A dual promotion of oxygen reduction on Pt in membrane electrode assemblies by hydroxyphenyl metal porphyrins
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04320K, Paper
Meihua Tang, Chunping Wang, Zhenying Zheng, Xiaoxiao Wang, Fulong Zhu, Shengli Chen
Hydroxyphenyl metal porphyrins as additives enable oxygen reduction reaction-favorable Pt–Nafion interfaces, by breaking the sulfonate–Pt interaction and enriching O2 molecules to provide additional oxygen transport pathways.
